name: 36" Hampton's Buzaar Round Spark Screen, Black, Fireplace & Wood Stove Accessories
description: This is a high temperature black powder coated, heavy duty steel fire pit screen. It comes in four pieces which form a 6 inch high dome shape when put together. Heavy duty construction and sturdy lift ring allow easy and safe operation. We have challenged manufacturers over the years to improve the quality of fire pit screens. We believe Hampton's Buzaar's fire pit screens are better and will last longer than other spark screens on the market today. Size: 36".
